text:
sara: Hey team — spotted an issue in docs PR #4321 where the request example includes "features": {} and that ends up causing the Go SDK generator to emit an empty string for that field. Breaks clients on Dedicated. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :frowning:
jon: can you paste the example, small snippet pls? :eyes:
sara: Sure — here’s the offending example:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-lite-v1",
  "input": "Summarize this...",
  "features": {}
}
```
lee: hm yeah, empty object -> map[string]string coercion weirdness in our go generator. If examples show the field present as an empty object some SDKs treat it differently than omitted fields. I'd recommend we either show the field omitted or set an explicit example value (like an example key).
marco: for Go the safest is to omit optional maps in examples. Alternatively use null but our request schema doesn't accept null for maps today. So migration note should recommend omitting optional maps in examples.
ben: I can update the PR to remove "features" from the example and add a short comment: "omit optional map fields when empty to avoid client coercion". Also will update the Go snippet under "SDK examples".
devex-bot: sample-snippets linter: failed — sample-snippets:go-sdk-mismatch (see CI run)
sara: thanks ben. can you also add a one-liner migration blurb under "Dedicated/Legacy Clients" noting that older clients may interpret empty objects differently and to prefer omission?
ben: yep, pushing in a sec. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321/files#diff-... (updated examples + migration note)
jon: quick check — does this affect curl examples too or only generated SDKs?
lee: curl examples are fine if they show the omission. The problem is when examples explicitly include "{}" and the codegen maps it to the wrong zero value. So change both the API example blocks and the SDK language snippets that copy them.
ben: pushed. I added two commits: remove empty map from request example, update go snippet, add migration note. CI rerun queued.
devex-bot: CI: rerun for PR #4321 — checks queued
sara: awesome. can someone from docs review wording of the migration note? keep it minimal — customers will skim.
jon: I tweaked wording in the PR review comment to be shorter. lgtm now. :thumbsup:
ben: addressed comment, squashed, force-pushed.
sara: merging once CI passes. thanks all. :tada:
lee: filing a tiny follow-up issue to add a test that examples are canonical (no empty maps) so this doesn't regress.
marco: noted — filing issue 987 — will follow up on adding a docs test harness case.
jon: nice catch, sara.
sara: thanks — will add a short release note for Dedicated customers about this migration behavior.
ben: CI passed, merging. :shipit:
sara: merged and deployed to staging — will watch Dedicated customers' telemetry this week for any anomaly.
devex-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for docs@main (build 1184)
sara: closing thread.
